title: P1-03 — OpenCode 2.2.5 TUI and exit-confirm compatibility
objective: P1-03 TUI compatibility and exit confirmation. Successor to #49/#51; starts after P1-01 ticket #53; compatibility findings inform P1-02 ticket #54, while guest integration/acceptance depends on #54. Timebox investigation before any port. Operating policy: docs/workflows/phase1-continuous-execution.md; this is M2 after integrated M1, with existing pinned-binary probes reused rather than repeated absent contradictory guest evidence.

acceptance_criteria.text: Timebox source/runtime compatibility investigation against pinned OpenCode 2.2.5 before porting; record verified behavior and stop for owner/Sol decision if compatibility or security boundaries are unclear.

Use supported native keybindings when they provide the approved behavior; verify Ctrl+C opens confirmation, Escape/N/Ctrl+C cancel, Y/Q confirm, and Ctrl+D behavior on the pinned binary without losing workspace data.

Any plugins/config are version-pinned, baked into the protected guest and inaccessible for workspace replacement; hostile project config/plugin discovery cannot override protected settings or load an unapproved plugin.

Verify update, telemetry, remote model-list, and sharing behavior under the existing egress policy; keep autoupdate/sharing disabled as configured and do not broaden the allowlist without owner approval.
Document target-terminal clipboard-write mitigation, verify it with a harmless clipboard canary, and state residual terminal-control risks; do not treat SSH EscapeChar=none as a clipboard defense.

needed: Timeboxed OpenCode 2.2.5 TUI/plugin/keybinding/config-precedence probe in an isolated disposable environment.
PTy key-sequence matrix and harmless OSC-52 clipboard canary on each owner-approved terminal profile.
Hostile project config/plugin sentinel and egress/update/model-list checks without real credentials.
created: Local pinned-binary PTY verification: scripts/verify-exit-confirm.py now rejects any opencode version other than 2.2.5 and uses a temporary HOME, empty workspace, private minimal server config, and sanitized environment; no inherited auth/session/config. On 2.2.5, all 10 checks pass: Ctrl+D inert, yq types while closed, Ctrl+C opens, Esc/N/Ctrl+C cancel, uppercase Y and Q confirm. `bats tests/exit-confirm.bats`: 6/6. No guest/owner-terminal clipboard canary, hostile project config test, guest provenance, egress test, or owner acceptance; criteria remain pending. Source checkpoint 01197bd plus verifier version-enforcement follow-up 3a30f2c.

CONFIG-PRECEDENCE (local pinned v2.2.5 only): commit 2a9be6e adds tests/opencode-project-config.test.py. In isolated temporary HOME/workspace, debug config discovers both direct and .opencode configs without guard; both are absent with OPENCODE_DISABLE_PROJECT_CONFIG=1, while protected config source reports updates disabled/share disabled. 2/2 tests pass. Does not prove effective config, project-plugin suppression/load, guest launch enforcement, or owner acceptance; A3 remains pending. Docs explicitly bound claim (94e32b0).

Project config/plugin probe current result (commits 2a9be6e/82fc434/79f4aac): tests/opencode-project-config.test.py 3/3 on v2.2.5. Confirms direct and .opencode config sources are absent under OPENCODE_DISABLE_PROJECT_CONFIG=1; a benign test-authored project plugin creates its private marker without the flag and not with the flag. Guarded negative also requires live TUI to reach Ask anything; no false pass on startup failure. No guest enforcement/effective-config/owner acceptance claim.

comments.author: cli
comments.body: Workflow reminder for #54–#57: record durable discussion, review findings, and owner decisions as append-only comments with the ticket-engine CLI (--comment), not as prose in tests.created. Keep test ledgers limited to concise test evidence and actionable test gaps.

comments.author: cli
comments.body: Sol Medium independent review of 01197bd plus 3a30f2c: PASS WITH MINOR CONCERNS, both actionable concerns resolved. The verifier enforces exact OpenCode 2.2.5, isolates HOME/workspace/server config, and drops inherited OpenCode auth/session/config env; rerun passed 10/10 PTY checks and Bats 6/6. No owner terminal, guest, egress, clipboard, or credential acceptance is inferred. No remaining material simplify/security finding.

comments.author: cli
comments.body: Sol Medium review of config-precedence probe commit 2a9be6e: PASS WITH MINOR DOCUMENTATION CONCERN. Isolated pinned-binary control-vs-guard tests are valid (2/2); project config sources appear normally and are omitted when OPENCODE_DISABLE_PROJECT_CONFIG=1. Review correctly noted this does not prove final effective config, plugin loading, or guest enforcement. Docs claim was narrowed in 94e32b0; A3 remains pending, and no A3 security acceptance is claimed.

comments.author: cli
comments.body: Sol Medium security review of 82fc434: PASS with minor test-quality caveat. The benign sentinel is confined to temporary state and the positive/negative control is appropriate; review noted absence alone could pass if TUI failed to start. Commit 79f4aac resolves this by requiring the guarded TUI to remain alive and reach Ask anything before checking no marker. Focused Sol delta confirmed the caveat closed. 3/3 config/plugin tests pass; protected guest launch enforcement remains pending.
